card.name: Supportive and symptomatic treatment wording
card.fires_on: Mainly the word piece "omatic" in "symptomatic" and the word "supportive", in overdose or NMS management text saying to give supportive or symptomatic care.

modes.label: Inside symptomatic
modes.description: The ending "omatic" of "symptomatic" before treatment, after "intensive" or "supportive".
modes.example: If NMS is suspected, immediately discontinue CAPLYTA and provide intensive sympt<<omatic>> treatment and monitoring.

modes.label: Supportive measures
modes.description: The word "supportive" after "general" in overdose management advice.
modes.example: Medical management should normally consist of general<< supportive>> measures, close observation of vital signs,

modes.label: Other stray words
modes.description: Occasional linking words like "that" or "the" in scattered sentences, with no clear link.
modes.example: Oxygen therapy means using an oxygen tank or a machine to breathe in air<< that>> contains more oxygen than normal.
